quarterly_data.quarter: Fujifilm press release: Fujifilm and Tata Electronics Announce Strategic (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Tata Electronics: Fujifilm and Tata Electronics signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) under which Fujifilm will develop and supply advanced semiconductor materials tailored to the requirements of Tata Electronics' upcoming semiconductor Fab in Dholera, Gujarat (described as India's first commercial Fab), and support Indian chemical manufacturers with technology, quality assurance and process know-how to localize high-purity chemicals. Fujifilm will invest approximately INR 800 Crores (~US$ 83 Million) to establish a semiconductor materials plant in the Dholera Special Investment Region (DSIR) in phases. Fujifilm Holdings CEO Teiichi Goto: the company positions its semiconductor materials business as a key growth driver for the group and sees India's semiconductor market as a critical opportunity. Named product range (EVP Tetsuya Iwasaki): photoresists, photolithography-related materials, CMP slurries, post-CMP cleaners, thin-film materials, ZEMATES polyimides, high-purity process chemicals and Wave Control Mosaic image-sensor color filter materials. No timeline, volumes or contract value stated (MoU).
quarterly_data.figure: ~INR 800 Crores (~US$ 83 Million) phased materials plant in Dholera, India
